RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

An all-woman panel is not evidence of anything. Panels skew in both directions constantly, and composition says nothing about reasoning. If you lead with it, you look like you're attributing your loss to the panel's sex rather than engaging with the criteria — which damages your credibility and any genuine complaint.

Your real grounds are concrete and far stronger: a documented qualifications gap on the formal criteria (completed PhD, six papers, four years teaching) and an unanswered statutory-style request for written reasons. Public universities usually owe you that.

Send a firm follow-up citing the relevant transparency rules and a deadline. If the reasons, when they arrive, don't match the advertised criteria, escalate on *that*.
